title: Whipped Grass-Fed Tallow Cream — Orange & Bergamot
body_html:
Start your morning with something your skin actually recognizes. This whipped tallow face cream combines the biological intelligence of pasture-raised grass-fed beef tallow with bright organic orange peel oil and clarifying bergamot — a daytime formula designed to moisturize deeply, absorb quickly, and lift your mood before you've finished your coffee. No seed oils. No synthetics. Just ancestral nourishment with a citrus edge.

Why whipped grass-fed tallow

Grass-fed beef tallow's fatty-acid composition — stearic, oleic, palmitic, and palmitoleic acids — mirrors the ratios found in healthy human sebum. That's not a coincidence; it's biology. Because the lipid profile is so similar to what your skin naturally produces, tallow absorbs efficiently and doesn't create the occlusive, greasy layer that synthetic creams leave behind. Your skin uses it rather than just sitting under it.

Grass-fed makes a meaningful difference: pasture-raised cattle produce tallow with higher concentrations of conjugated linoleic acid (CLA), more fat-soluble vitamins A, D, E, and K, and a more favorable omega-3 to omega-6 ratio. These nutrients support skin renewal, barrier integrity, and a calm, even complexion — delivered in a bioavailable form that synthetic alternatives can't replicate.

  • Sebum-compatible lipid profile — absorbs without blocking pores or leaving residue
  • Grass-fed advantage — richer in CLA, fat-soluble vitamins, and balanced omegas
  • Natural vitamin A — supports healthy cell turnover without the irritation of retinol
  • Zero synthetic emulsifiers — tallow's structure makes them unnecessary

The scent

Organic orange peel oil opens the formula with a warm, ripe citrus brightness — antioxidant-rich and immediately uplifting. Bergamot follows with a more complex, slightly floral-citrus depth that rounds off the orange's sweetness. The result is bright without being sharp, energizing without being jarring. It's a morning scent: the kind that makes getting up earlier feel like a reasonable idea.

Key ingredients

  • Grass-fed beef tallow — nutrient-dense, sebum-compatible base; rich in fat-soluble vitamins and skin-native fatty acids
  • Organic olive oil — contributes squalene and oleic acid for deep softening and skin conditioning
  • Organic jojoba oil — a liquid wax technically, not an oil — closely mimics sebum and aids smooth, residue-free absorption
  • Organic orange peel oil — rich in limonene and antioxidants; brightening, mood-lifting, supports even tone
  • Organic bergamot peel oil — clarifying, balancing, fresh citrus-floral; commonly used in skincare for its toning properties

What it does

  • Morning moisture without heaviness — deeply nourishing but absorbs fully so it layers under SPF or light makeup
  • Antioxidant radiance — orange peel oil contributes limonene and natural antioxidants that support a brighter-looking complexion
  • Barrier repair and maintenance — tallow's lipid density rebuilds the moisture barrier depleted by washing, weather, and stress
  • Pore-friendly hydration — sebum-compatible fats moisturize without clogging; suitable for combination skin
  • Mood-lifting aromatherapy — citrus essential oils have well-documented uplifting effects on mood and alertness

How to use

  1. After cleansing in the morning, scoop a pea-sized amount onto fingertips.
  2. Warm between palms for 2–3 seconds until the cream softens.
  3. Press and massage into face, neck, and décolletage until fully absorbed.
  4. Follow with SPF — this is a daytime moisturizer, and sun protection is always the final step.

Who it's for

The Orange & Bergamot cream was built for the morning routine. If you want a clean moisturizer that brightens your skin and lifts your mood before you face the day, this is your jar. It's especially well suited for normal-to-combination skin, anyone avoiding seed-oil-based moisturizers, and crunchy moms who want their morning skincare to feel intentional rather than obligatory.

Free from

No seed oils • No parabens • No sulfates • No synthetic fragrance • No PEGs • No phthalates

Our sourcing story

Leaf & Bird's tallow is rendered from pasture-raised, grass-fed cattle — animals living on open land as they were meant to. We source with a nose-to-tail philosophy: using what has already been raised, wasting nothing. Tallow was a staple of ancestral skincare for centuries — our grandmothers' generation didn't need an ingredient panel to know it worked. We're simply returning to what was always true, blended with organic essential oils for a modern ritual.

Size & specs

2 oz (56g) · Made in USA · 100% Organic Oils · Store in a cool location away from direct sunlight.

Full ingredient list

Grass-Fed Beef Tallow, Organic Olive Oil, Organic Jojoba Oil, Organic Orange Peel Oil, Organic Bergamot Peel Oil

Suggested use: Apply a small amount to fingertips and massage into skin. Fully absorbs after a few minutes. Best used in the morning followed by SPF. A little goes a long way.

Warning: For external use only. Avoid direct contact with eyes. Discontinue use if irritation occurs. Bergamot may increase photosensitivity — always apply SPF when using this product during the day. Keep out of reach of children. Store in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight.

faq_json.question: What does this cream smell like?
faq_json.answer: Leaf & Bird's Orange & Bergamot tallow cream opens with warm, ripe organic orange peel oil — bright and slightly sweet — then settles into the more complex floral-citrus depth of bergamot. The overall effect is uplifting and energizing without being sharp or overpowering. The scent fades within 20–30 minutes of application, making it a pleasant morning ritual rather than a lasting perfume.

faq_json.question: Does bergamot make skin more sensitive to sunlight?
faq_json.answer: Bergamot essential oil can contain furocoumarins — compounds that increase photosensitivity and can cause phototoxic reactions when skin is exposed to UV light. Our formula uses organic bergamot peel oil; we recommend applying SPF after this cream whenever you'll be outdoors or in daylight, as a precaution regardless of furocoumarin content. This is a daytime moisturizer — treating it as a pre-SPF step is the correct use anyway. If you have known bergamot sensitivity, the Lemongrass & Lavender variant is a safer choice.

faq_json.question: How long does one jar last?
faq_json.answer: At daily facial use, a 2 oz jar typically lasts 6–10 weeks. Tallow cream is highly concentrated — a pea-sized amount warms quickly and spreads across the full face and neck. Using more than you need won't improve results. If you're applying to larger body areas daily, expect the jar to last 3–4 weeks.

faq_json.question: Is this safe to use during pregnancy?
faq_json.answer: The formula contains grass-fed beef tallow, organic olive oil, organic jojoba oil, organic orange peel oil, and organic bergamot peel oil — no retinoids, no salicylic acid, no parabens, and no synthetic fragrance. Please consult your healthcare provider or OB/GYN before introducing any new skincare product during pregnancy or while breastfeeding. This is informational only and not medical advice.

faq_json.question: Can I use this on my baby?
faq_json.answer: The ingredient list is very simple and free of synthetic additives. However, citrus essential oils — including orange and bergamot — can occasionally cause sensitivity in very young or newborn skin. We recommend the Leaf & Bird Lemongrass & Lavender or Peaceful Night variant for infants, or performing a small patch test and observing for 24 hours before broader application. Consult your pediatrician before use on babies. This is not medical advice.

faq_json.question: Can I layer this under sunscreen or foundation?
faq_json.answer: Yes — this is the intended daytime workflow. Apply a pea-sized amount of tallow cream, allow 3–5 minutes for full absorption, then apply your SPF on top as the final protective layer. The cream absorbs cleanly without leaving a heavy residue, so it works well as a moisturizing base under mineral or chemical sunscreens. It can also layer under lightweight foundation or tinted SPF.

faq_json.question: How much cream should I use per application?
faq_json.answer: Start with a pea-sized amount for your full face and neck. Warm it between your fingers for a few seconds and it will soften significantly, becoming easy to press and spread. Tallow is richly concentrated — using a larger amount won't absorb faster or deliver better results. For body areas like arms or legs, a coin-sized amount per zone is a good starting point.
